title: glue_strings
summary: Benilla parses Interface/GlueXML/GlueStrings.lua off the player's client data (KEY = "value" lines) for the glue screens' localized paragraphs and captions, never embedding Blizzard text. MSUI does the same: Formats/GlueStrings.cs loads the table from client data and the create screen quotes the FACTION_INFO_*/RACE_INFO_*/ABILITY_INFO_* paragraphs and captions from it, with graceful absence.
